description.p: MarketLab Terminal is a native C++ desktop financial research workspace featuring public market data, local analytics, historical simulation, portfolio research, report building, and Python analytics scripts.

ul.li: Public market data across equities, crypto, economics, and news
Historical simulation without an external order-execution route
Python analytics across equity, derivatives, fixed income, and quant research
Visual workflow node editor with risk management
Geopolitics, prediction markets, and maritime tracking

description.p: Local-first MarketLab baseline with the former assistant, model-provider, agent, voice-assistant, and related hosted subsystems removed.
